description: Transpiled CZ count of the K=7 Krylov-Trotter sampler circuits (k=0..6) on ibm_fez. k=0 has no entangling gate and is excluded from every summary (k>=1). 'reproduction': FakeFez transpilation of build_circuit(k) with each job script's transpile call, seeds 0-4. 'deployed': the ISA circuits actually submitted, decoded from the job inputs and identified against build_circuit(k) by the total-variation distance of their output distributions.
